item.description:
## Open hi-hats close where you want - Put a Pedal Hi-Hat (foot) note where the hi-hat closes. The foot shows below the stave and a "+" shows above it at the same beat. - The next hand hi-hat no longer gets a stray "+". - The Close tool moves the "+" to the note you mark, instead of adding a second one.
## Worksheets (since 137) - Double-click an exercise to edit it on the grid; changes save into the exercise. - Drag exercise cards to reorder them. - Rename with the pencil or right-click. Replacing an exercise keeps its name. - Card icons are visible in dark mode and when selected.
This build is 143.

## Open hi-hats close where you want - Put a Pedal Hi-Hat (foot) note where the hi-hat closes. The notation shows the foot and no longer adds a "+" to the next hand hi-hat. - The Close tool now moves the "+" to the note you mark, instead of adding a second one.
## Worksheets (since 137) - Double-click an exercise to edit it on the grid; changes save into the exercise. - Drag exercise cards to reorder them. - Rename with the pencil or right-click. Replacing an exercise keeps its name. - Card icons are visible in dark mode and when selected.
This build is 142.

## Edit worksheet exercises on the grid - Double-click an exercise card to open it on the grid. Every change you make is saved into that exercise automatically. - A banner above the grid shows which exercise you're editing. Click Done when you've finished. - Rename an exercise with the pencil beside its name, or right-click > Rename Exercise.
## Also since 137 - Drag exercise cards to reorder them. - Card icons are visible in dark mode and when selected. - Replacing an exercise keeps its name.
This build is 141.

## Worksheets - Drag an exercise card to move it. A blue line shows where it will land: drop on the left half of a card to go before it, the right half to go after it. Escape cancels. - The move, duplicate and delete icons on exercise cards are now visible in dark mode and when the card is selected. - Rename an exercise on the worksheet page: double-click its name, or right-click and choose Rename Exercise. - Replacing an exercise keeps its name and only updates the notation.
This build is 140.

## Worksheet exercise names - Rename an exercise right on the worksheet page: double-click its name, or right-click and choose Rename Exercise. - Replacing an exercise now keeps its name and only updates the notation. Previously the name was overwritten with the Groove name, so renames didn't stick.
Also includes everything in 137. This build is 138.

## Faster chart tempo - Song Chart Builder now has a tempo slider, like the main window. - Click and drag the BPM number: right or up to speed up, left or down to slow down. Hold Option for fine control. - The arrows still step 1 BPM at a time, and a whole drag undoes in one step.
Also includes everything in 136. This build is 137.

## Safer saving - If your library can't be read in full, BeatBake now keeps a copy of the original file, opens everything it can, and tells you. Nothing is overwritten. - Pending saves finish when you close Chart Builder or quit. If a save fails on quit, you can cancel and keep working. - New or Open over an edited chart asks you to Save, Discard, or Cancel. - Groove undo now goes back 100 steps (was 5).
## Song Chart Builder - Choose individual bars or grouped rests when adding bars and sections. - Delete Bar button beside Add Bar. - Left/Right arrows move between bars, Up returns to bar 1, and the selected bar scrolls into view. - Chart Builder uses a single window: opening it again brings your chart forward. - Faster drawing and playback on long charts.
## Playback and licensing - Steadier timing at fast tempos. - The seven-day offline grace starts as soon as you activate your licence.
This build is 136 (was 133).
